subject: Re: OrchardAI + Redwood — Technical talk series: Productionizing RAI
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha@orchardai.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: liam.oneill@orchardai.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: OrchardAI + Redwood: proposal for technical talk series (Productionizing RAI)

Hi Ben,

Hope you're well — I'm Aisha (Head of Partnerships at OrchardAI). We chatted briefly at the Vector Summit; OrchardAI builds a retrieval layer and lightweight retriever orchestration used by several enterprise customers. We've had strong inbound interest in practical sessions about bringing retrieval-augmented inference (RAI) into production, and we'd love to partner with Redwood on a short technical talk series targeted at ML engineers and platform teams.

Quick outline (attached: RAI-program-outline.pdf and proposed-dates.csv):
- 3 x 45-minute sessions (30m talk + 15m live Q&A)
  - Session A: "RAI foundations: retrieval signals and embeddings at scale"
  - Session B: "Serving architectures for low-latency RAI (memory & KV cache patterns)"
  - Session C: "Cost engineering: batching, quantization, and cache strategies in practice"
- Target audience: infra/platform/ML engineers at Series B+ companies; expected 800–1,500 registrants across the series
- Promotional plan: joint landing page, co-branded emails, 3 social pushes, partner blogs swap
- Asks from Redwood: 1–2 technical speakers (engineer/engineering manager), brief speaker bios, logo for landing page, and a point of contact for logistics

We don't need this to be a paid webinar — OrchardAI can cover webinar platform costs. We do ask for a small co-marketing commitment to boost cross-promo (we typically recommend $5k to run paid social and paid re-targeting). If that's a hard no, we can flex on paid promo and lean on organic channels.

Do you have capacity to do this in Nov/Dec? If so, can you share which Redwood speakers are available and any constraints on co-marketing? We're flexible on format and can run a live series or record and publish as a short learning track — whichever is easiest operationally.

If useful I can share a draft landing page and a joint promo calendar (live Drive link).

Thanks — excited about this.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of Partnerships, OrchardAI
Aisha@orchardai.com

Attachments:
- RAI-program-outline.pdf (1p)
- proposed-dates.csv (3 columns: session, week-of, rehearsal-window)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-28T11:20:00-07:00

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear outline and the attachments. Really like the scope — three focused sessions hit the sweet spot for engineers. We're interested.

High-level responses / constraints:
- Redwood can provide two speakers per session (mix of SEs and a PM/engineer). I'll confirm exact names, but likely: Karthik Iyer (Solutions Eng) for deployment/serving and a backend engineer from infra for caching/KV patterns.
- Co-marketing budget: I need to check with our partnerships budget. $5k is reasonable for many of these co-markets; I'll see if we can commit to that.
- Timing: Nov works if rehearsals can be scheduled the week prior to each session. We prefer weekday late-mornings (US PST) to maximize attendance across US/EU.
- Deliverables we'd need from OrchardAI: landing page mock (PNG), final speaker bios (short, 1–2 lines), headshot(s), and a shared calendar for rehearsals.

I'll loop in Marissa (partnerships) to coordinate logistics and Karthik (solutions) to scope demos and length. Marissa — can you take lead on promotional calendar and landing page? Karthik — can you review the technical topics below and suggest which demos are realistic for a 20–25 minute slot?

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Marissa to own landing page and registration flow (we can host the page on Redwood's marketing site)
2) OrchardAI to share landing page mock + final session descriptions by Oct 31
3) Redwood to confirm speakers and rough demo plan by Nov 3
4) Schedule rehearsals 1 week before each session

I'm attaching our speaker bios (rwd-speaker-bios.docx) so you can include them in the landing page. Happy to jump on a 30-min sync if that's easier.
